meta_description: A1 Decorators Liverpool offers professional interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wall treatments. Free quotes, reliable service. Call 07922 240937.
hero_subhead: Tired of living with tired walls? We transform Liverpool homes with expert painting, wallpapering, and interior finishes—on time, on budget.
services_subhead: From a single bedroom refresh to full-house makeovers, we handle interior and exterior decoration with meticulous attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: We refresh living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and bathrooms with premium paints and expert application. Colour consultation included to help you get it right first time.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes for walls, woodwork, fascias, and soffits. We prepare surfaces properly and use trade-grade paints that last.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Whether it's feature walls, textured finishes, or patterned wallpaper, we measure precisely and hang straight. Difficult corners? We've got this covered.

services.title: Woodwork & Staining
services.desc: Doors, skirting, architraves, and fitted furniture get careful preparation and quality finishes. We can stain, varnish, or paint to match your scheme perfectly.

services.title: Damp Remediation Preparation
services.desc: Before re-decorating damp-affected areas, we work with you to prepare surfaces and recommend treatment options to prevent moisture returning.

services.title: Commercial & Retail Spaces
services.desc: We understand tight timescales for shops, offices, and hospitality venues. Early starts, minimal disruption, and professional results every time.

about_pullquote: I started A1 Decorators because I wanted to prove decorators could be honest, turn up on time, and do brilliant work.
about_para_1: A1 Decorators has been transforming Liverpool properties since 2008. We began as a one-man operation with a simple mission: deliver professional decorating without the fuss or hidden costs. Over sixteen years, we've grown to a trusted local name, completing over 1,200 interior and exterior projects across Merseyside. Our reputation is built on quality preparation, attention to detail, and keeping our promises.
about_para_2: Homeowners and local businesses come back to us because we listen, we show up on time, and we care about the finish as much as they do. We don't cut corners on surface prep—it's the difference between a decoration that looks good in a year and one that looks stunning for a decade. You'll find us in Gleave Crescent, but our work speaks for itself right across Liverpool.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About A1 Decorators

reviews.text: Had the whole house done—lounge, hallway, kitchen, and two bedrooms. Mark and his team were brilliant. Tidy, professional, and they actually listened when we changed our mind about a colour halfway through. Finished on time, fair price. Absolutely recommend.
reviews.author: Helen T.

reviews.text: Needed my shop redecorated before a refit. A1 came in early, worked around my trading hours, and got it done to a standard I didn't expect at that price. They even sorted out a damp patch before painting. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Rajesh P.

reviews.text: Second time we've used them now. First time was the spare bedroom, this time the whole downstairs. They're reliable, they turn up when they say they will, and the finish is always immaculate. A bit of prep chat before they start, and then they get on with it. Honest lads.
reviews.author: Christine M.
